issues.description: The template header declaration for ray_sphere_intersect declares an int return type, but the implementation (CPP) defines the function returning bool. The solution repository uses bool in the header and implementation. This return-type mismatch in the template (header vs implementation) will cause a compile-time / linkage error and prevents the provided template from compiling as-is — contradicting the exercise requirement that the assignment must compile. Students will be confused which return type to use and will be blocked by the type conflict when building the example program.
